A phone number is checked as a phone number, an amount as money and a quantity as a whole number, so a stray mark doesn’t turn into a wrong balance.

Every field carries a confidence level. Clear values go straight to review; smudged digits, crossed-out entries and totals that don’t add up are highlighted for a person to confirm.

tree: What does it extract from a page?
The rows and fields on it: names, phone numbers, emails, amounts, quantities, product codes, dates and notes, depending on the kind of page.

tree.style: background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px 20px;

tree: What happens when it can’t read something?
The field is highlighted with a lower confidence so you can correct it, and you can reprocess the page or retake the photo.

tree.style: background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px 20px;

tree: Yes. Values are checked as the kind of field they are, and totals that don’t match their lines are flagged.

tree.style: background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px 20px;

tree: Can I edit the extracted table?
Yes. Edit any cell or row before approving. The original page stays alongside for comparison.
